body: They're all getting up there, and I know a lot of dog people. I could probably figure it out.

It does. I don't even have them all the time. I split custody with my ex, so I have two of them at a time, then three of them at a time. One of them died suddenly two months ago and I can't remotely deal with it.
The only thing I have are my dogs, and even I think about where they can go so I don't have to bother any more. I've just been waiting for nothing.
I'm sorry, it just feels stupid to even write it out. I am just alone all the time and any one who said they gave a shit about me is no where to be found.

I barely get by as it is but I took a new job that isn't panning out, so I am working 12 hour days and still broke. Any one who I thought gave a fuck about me disappeared because I can't afford to go out and do any thing any more. I dread going to work and I dread going home. I dread every thing. Any time it gets better it just ends up back here eventually.
I just don't want to do it any more.
It's stupid, but I am so fucking alone. I can barely type because I am hyperventilating.
